response.sql: SELECT COALESCE(p.bats, '') AS bats, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS distinct_managers, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id)) OVER () AS share FROM manager_award ma INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '') ORDER BY bats

assumptions.assumption: Share is expressed as a percentage (0–100 scale) rather than as a decimal proportion (0–1 scale). Both interpretations are consistent with 'share of the total', but percentage is the more common convention.

alternatives.interpretation: Share is expressed as a decimal proportion (0–1 scale) rather than a percentage.
alternatives.sql: SELECT COALESCE(p.bats, '') AS bats, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS distinct_managers, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id)) OVER () AS share FROM manager_award ma INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '') ORDER BY bats
